ideas.pitch: An AI-powered lease and sublet agreement analyzer that uncovers predatory hidden clauses, illegal fees, and tenant rights violations that students and young professionals blindly sign.
ideas.problem_statement: Hidden inefficiencies in everyday routines and systems
ideas.title: SubletShield
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets an extremely common, painful everyday problem with immediate utility, aligning with the Hack the Unseen theme by exposing legal traps hidden in plain sight.

ideas.pitch: A pedestrian navigation and micro-audit web app that maps poorly lit streets, missing sidewalks, and broken ramps using crowd-sourced sensor data and street view imagery.
ideas.problem_statement: Accessibility challenges that often go unnoticed
ideas.title: AuraRoute
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly addresses civic accessibility and public safety with a clear, measurable community impact that appeals strongly to judging panels looking for real-world utility.

ideas.pitch: An automated household inventory tracker using edge computer vision on cheap ESP32 cameras to detect and alert users about expiring food items before they become kitchen waste.
ideas.title: PantryPulse
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines hardware/edge perception with a relatable household problem, demonstrating a live-working prototype that solves hidden food waste.

ideas.pitch: A browser extension that intercepts and analyzes deceptive URL shorteners, QR codes in public spaces, and hidden affiliate redirects before a user lands on a malicious site.
ideas.problem_statement: Digital safety, fraud detection, privacy, and online threats
ideas.title: PhishLens
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles modern digital threats that people overlook every day, offering tangible protection with a slick, instantly demonstrable browser UI.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight, low-bandwidth digital token and queue management system designed specifically for local neighborhood clinics and small public dispensaries that still rely on chaotic paper registers.
ideas.problem_statement: Making essential services more accessible and efficient
ideas.title: MedQueue
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an invisible inefficiency in local grassroots healthcare services with an ultra-low friction deployment model that judges can immediately appreciate.
